ideas.title: Following the Money in Meal-Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of meal-fraud schemes to identify patterns and connections between entities
questions: What are the common characteristics of meal-fraud schemes?
How do these schemes use financial networks to launder money?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of meal-fraud schemes, we can identify patterns and connections between entities that may indicate a larger network of fraud and abuse.
